method.acoustic: Seven 25 ms Hann windows centered at steps of 20 ms from -60 to +60 ms around each native picture. Log relative spectrum in twelve fixed bands and overall energy relative to the clip 95th percentile.
method.advancement: At least three added correct locations across two held groups, at least 75% assessed coverage on edits and ordinary views, at most one added ordinary alert, and no new constant-offset alert.
method.compare: Measure local compatibility change relative to one shared reference lag on both 400 ms flanks. Use only exactly shared frames with strong visual states and at least two states in the proposed range. Rank by the smallest of the three signed alignment gains.
method.fit: Balanced L2 logistic regression (C=.05) predicts open versus closed only from original aligned speech, with point/held speakers excluded. The bounded input model sees no picture, raw speaker label or edit variants.
method.localization: At least 0.40 temporal intersection over union and signed displacement error at most two native pictures.
method.observation: Closed is a median three-gap aperture at most .055 and open is at least .100, normalized by eye distance. Intermediate and unavailable measurements abstain.
method.operating_point: Strictly above the largest ordinary maximum among the two excluded point groups, with all controls retained.
method.source: Previously unplanned exact GRID utterances from fixed publisher archives. Groups are disjoint across fit, point and held. Speaker groups have prior project exposure.
